clips.title: The story
paras: Northwest of Deathknell, spiders infest a gold mine the Forsaken need. Executor Arren sends newly risen recruits into the cavern to cull the spiders piece by piece. Raw materials are scarce, and the mine's wealth could sustain the Forsaken settlement and war effort.

Executor Arren oversees operations in Deathknell, where the newly risen Forsaken struggle to survive. They face the Scourge and Scarlet crusaders, but defending themselves is only part of the work. A fledgling society also needs raw materials. Precious metals such as gold were scarce in northern Lordaeron even when the Alliance was strong. Arren knows the Forsaken need wealth to arm and equip themselves and establish their society.

A natural cavern called Night Web's Hollow lies northwest of Deathknell's cemetery, with a gold vein running through it. Monstrous spiders have overrun its tunnels, leaving thick webs and deadly venom in their depths. Arren has too few seasoned troops for a full purge, so fresh recruits thin the young and adult spiders. Once the danger is reduced, mining crews can burn away the webs and extract the ore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: One of our greatest struggles is obtaining the natural resources we need to survive. Gold was scarce even in the height of the Alliance's power.

There is a gold mine to the northwest that has been overrun with spiders. We need gold from the mine, but we can't very well get it while the spiders are crawling around in there. I've not much manpower to commit to the task, so we'll just have to do it little by little.
Get up there and see what you can do for us, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Be wary of the spiders' venom, friend. If you feel a sharp burning, you may want to have it looked at.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmm, well, it's a start. It'll take a few weeks or months to fully clean out the infestation. After that, we'll have to get down there with some torches to burn away the webbing.
You've done your duty well, friend, I'm sure I can find something else for you to do.
